source_evidence: 2 ARITHMETIC EXPRESSIONS 2.1 Simple Expressions You may have seen mathematical phrases like 13 + 2, 20 – 4, 12 × 5, and 18 ÷ 3.
Every arithmetic expression has a value which is the number it evaluates to.
This expression can be read as ‘13 plus 2’ or ‘the sum of 13 and 2’.
We use the equality sign ‘=’ to denote the relationship between an arithmetic expression and its value.
Example 1: Mallika spends ₹25 every day for lunch at school.
